text:
**Best practical pick: BLUETTI AC180 + 200W solar panel kit**, listed at **$729**. It’s explicitly identified as a home-backup pick, and the bundle keeps you under budget with a panel included. [See the kit and current offer](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-ac180-200w-solar-kit); another roundup also names the AC180 as its home-backup choice ([WPA Pool](https://www.wpa-pool.com/best-solar-generators-under-1000/)).

**If you can wait for a preorder:** the **ALLPOWERS P1800 + 400W panel kit** is listed at **$698** and offers 1 kWh of LiFePO₄ storage and an 1,800W inverter—but the listing says it ships Dec. 7. [Check the listing](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-p1800-sp037-solar-kit).

Either is for essential devices, not whole-home backup; check the seller’s current stock and price before ordering.
